scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: Bring the pack together
scenes.caption: Aditi and Vihaan bring the fictional bulletin document, participation chart and sharing ledger to the Decision Lab release board. Each card serves a purpose. The teacher requires privacy, access, source and recovery checks, then explicit approval before publication.
scenes.speech: Aditi and Vihaan bring the fictional bulletin document, participation chart and sharing ledger to the Decision Lab release board. Each card serves a purpose. The teacher requires privacy, access, source and recovery checks, then explicit approval before publication.
scenes.dialogue: A release needs all its stated criteria.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: Two different failures
scenes.caption: The chart download includes an unnecessary time breakdown with a tiny invented group. Separately, a visitor can edit the draft through its link. Vihaan records two failures: fixing chart fields would not repair excessive editing permission.
scenes.speech: The chart download includes an unnecessary time breakdown with a tiny invented group. Separately, a visitor can edit the draft through its link. Vihaan records two failures: fixing chart fields would not repair excessive editing permission.
scenes.dialogue: Different failures need their own changes and tests.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: A recovery check passes
scenes.caption: Their independent recovery point restores in a separate test area and passes its manifest comparison. The source record also matches the approved material. Aditi marks those criteria passed while retaining the chart and access failures on the board.
scenes.speech: Their independent recovery point restores in a separate test area and passes its manifest comparison. The source record also matches the approved material. Aditi marks those criteria passed while retaining the chart and access failures on the board.
scenes.dialogue: One pass does not erase another failure.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Choose revise
scenes.caption: The team chooses revise rather than go. They remove time detail from the public export and replace visitor editing with read-only final-bulletin access. Named editors retain draft permission for remaining corrections.
scenes.speech: The team chooses revise rather than go. They remove time detail from the public export and replace visitor editing with read-only final-bulletin access. Named editors retain draft permission for remaining corrections.
scenes.dialogue: Repair the failed criteria without breaking required work.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: Retest the revised items
scenes.caption: The public download now contains activity totals only. A fresh visitor test reads the final bulletin and cannot save an edit; a named editor can still correct the draft. These checks pass, but teacher approval remains pending.
scenes.speech: The public download now contains activity totals only. A fresh visitor test reads the final bulletin and cannot save an edit; a named editor can still correct the draft. These checks pass, but teacher approval remains pending.
scenes.dialogue: Successful checks are evidence for approval, not approval itself.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Approval opens publication
scenes.caption: The teacher reviews the evidence and explicitly approves this revised fictional release. Only then does the publication gate open. Your release decision must preserve tested settings, recovery and approval records, and name changes requiring another review.
scenes.speech: The teacher reviews the evidence and explicitly approves this revised fictional release. Only then does the publication gate open. Your release decision must preserve tested settings, recovery and approval records, and name changes requiring another review.
scenes.dialogue: Approval belongs to the reviewed release.
